# Agent Fleet Command — Index for AI Agents

Use this file to discover which skill to load. Each skill lives in a directory of the same name under skills/ and contains SKILL.md.

## Skills

agent-fleet-command
  Multi-agent orchestration: main agent creates documents and dispatches, sub-agents implement in dependency-based phases, each sub-agent creates its own reviewer sub-agent. Incremental and final consistency checks. Main agent never writes code.
  Triggers: multi-agent, orchestration, parallel execution, phased development, subagent, code review, quality gates, consistency checks, project management, task dispatch, review chain.
